_schema.note: Constitutional vocabulary. Every locale renders these terms identically, so the same concept never appears under two names across pages, decks, subtitles and social posts. Machine translation is CONSTRAINED to these: scripts/i18n/translate_catalog.py injects them into the provider prompt and scripts/i18n/check.mjs fails a catalog that renders one off-base.

fields.pos: part of speech, so a translator knows if it is a noun or a verb
fields.context: what the term means HERE, which is often not its ordinary sense
fields.spoken: how it is read aloud, where that differs (lane 11 dubs these)
fields.do_not_translate: true = ships in English in every locale

_schema.never_translated: ID tokens (R-/WF-/F-/I-/CLK-) and article citations (Art. ... §...) are never translated in any locale, including the pseudo-locale. This is enforced by check.mjs C4, not left to reviewer discipline.

Jurisdiction.context: A governed place at any scale, from a neighbourhood to the planet.

Legislature.context: The elected chamber of a jurisdiction; sized by the cube-root law.

Executive.context: The executive body — a committee or a single officeholder.

Constituent.context: A person represented by a seat; not a customer, not a subject.

Supermajority.context: Two-thirds of ALL serving members, not merely those present.

Majority.context: More than half of all serving members.

Quorum.context: The minimum serving members needed to act.

Residency.context: Physical presence establishing the right to vote and to stand.

Resident.context: A person whose residency is confirmed in a jurisdiction.

Ballot.context: The secret record of one voter’s choices.

Election.context: The whole contest, not a single round of counting.

Referendum.context: A question put directly to constituents.

Candidate.context: A person standing for a seat.

Committee.context: A working subgroup of a legislature.

Speaker.context: The presiding member of a chamber.

Bill.context: A proposed law before it passes.

Act.context: A single legislative decision, including non-law acts.

Emergency power.context: Time-limited authority; never longer than 90 days.

Organization.context: Any registered body: party, business, nonprofit, or CGC.

Common Good Corporation.context: A corporation whose IP is permanently public domain.
Common Good Corporation.spoken: Read in full; never the initials "CGC" when spoken.

Jury.context: Constituents drawn at random to decide a case.

Advocate.context: A person who argues a case.

Warrant.context: Judicial authorization for a specific act.

Disintermediation.context: A jurisdiction leaving an intermediate layer of government.

Restoration.context: Returning a lapsed jurisdiction to operation.

Audit log.context: The hash-chained, append-only record of every act.

Public record.context: The permanent, public, immutable record of an act. WF-SYS-03 is the only constitutional translation mandate in the system, and its own subject was untranslated until now.

Testimony.context: A constituent’s account entered into the civic record. A first-class civic artifact with its own route and federation path.
